comments.value: Its been months since I have been having this issue and more and more of my friends are starting to see the black frame issue with multiple video players since the sticker update.
This issue has not yet been resolved.

It has been ages, and this hasn't been fixed yet. I get it - upgrading AVPro in VRC might be tricky, since it's a new major version - but can we at least have a workaround that ships with VRChat for the time being?
This issue still hasn't been resolved.
Build 1861, currently on open-beta, has updated AVPro to 3.3.6, which should address this issue.

@{62b61f8ec938a62475e4cd14|full_name} I just tested Build 1861 (beta) on PCVR (using Virtual Desktop). The videoplayer works normally, but the flickering is still there. The flickering only stops when I use the VRChat launch parameter “--disable-hw-video-decoding.” Build 1861 didn't fix the flickering issue for me.

ps: i'm using a merlin based videoplayer
@{66bb3ee63ea89e011c428731|full_name}: I'm afraid that might be something to report to AVPro upstream then?
Scratch that, we may have found an issue that caused the update to be incomplete. We'll have more in the next beta update.

@{62b61f8ec938a62475e4cd14|full_name} today the new beta build 1862 was released and now it works for PCVR - no flicker of videos! With this version it's save for me to remove the steam startup parameter for cpu based videodecoding. 

And i don't have seen any impacts with the new AVPro version in my videoplayer system (also multichannel surround sound is working).

Thanks!
